D171 in the slice window: two of five round-2 votes were unread (a 2-word cite; a cite not in the proposal). The product manager's re-ask counted. The delivery lead's re-ask cited a commit subject instead of the proposal, so that seat was replaced in least-recently-used order (Copilot placed first, no reply; then Claude, counted). Retro point: does the cite rule catch unread votes, or only format slips?

D171 again: in the cap and threshold windows two Claude seats cited the slice instead of the proposal they were shown; the re-ask rule fixed both. Every Copilot seat placed by the gate returned no reply all day (card 229).
